title: Builder drag reorder and column size

entries.summary: HTML5 drag-and-drop reorder via ⋮⋮ handle for sections, rows, columns, and modules. Column widths 1–12 with slider and edge-resize; min_height and valign in column settings.
No schema change. New keys live in layout_json settings (min_height, valign) and column width.

Headed spec cms-builder-drag-column-size.spec.ts demos ⋮⋮ reorder, 1–12 slider, edge resize, min-height/valign, and public render. npm run test:e2e:cms-builder-drag-column-size (BASE_URL from .env.playwright or env.playwright).
